verdict.rationale: Kimi documents agentic delegation: the Kimi Code CLI and Desktop let the agent read and edit code, run commands, and "autonomously complete development tasks." The help center also lists an agent mode, Agent clusters, scheduled tasks, and deep research, and the homepage invites users to start an "Agent task." None of this explicitly describes tasks running in the background while the user is away and then returning a reviewable result; the agent work is described as conversational. missing for 10: explicit documentation of background/asynchronous task execution, a defined review/hand-back workflow for completed tasks, in-depth docs on agent mode and Agent cluster behavior beyond help-center headings, independent hands-on corroboration of background delegation.
